title: Uruguayan Rice Pilaf
description: A simple yet flavorful side dish from Uruguay, made with aromatic spices and long-grain rice.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: such as saffron, cumin, and paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add aromatic spices, salt, and pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil and spice mixture.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until water is absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork and serve hot.
